Class Road

java.lang.Object
Road
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Road>
public class Road extends Object implements Comparable<Road>
Road.java A road (edge) connecting two towns in the undirected road-network graph. A road from A to B is the same as a road from B to A. Roads sort by name, then by distance, then by the towns they connect.
Author:
Armel Daryl Kelodjoue Nguetchouang

      public int compareTo(Road o)
      Compares this road to another road for sorting. First compares by name, then by weight, and finally by connected towns.

      Parameters:

      Returns:

    • equals

      public boolean equals(Object obj)
      Checks equality of two roads. Roads are equal if they connect the same towns (in either order), and have same weight and name.
